notes.title: HOTFIX 1.01
notes.content:
Release Notes 08/01/2016. 

Hi guys, thank you all for your feedback and support for PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate. We plan to continue our support for PJSU in the future and with that on the 8th of January we pushed out a quick Hotfix to rectify an issue before we begin, please see notes below. 

[h1]Changes[/h1] 
[list]
    [*]Debug Code - We discovered we accidentally left in a debug code to clear Achievements by pressing F9, this was for testing purposes and accidentally left in the retail version of the game. (Oops.) 

Our apologies to everyone for this inconvenience. 
[/list]


[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Audio Stopping/Music Skipping.
[/list]


Thank you all once again, if you have any other suggestions or general questions feel free to contact me via Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/D11_Darquette]@D11_Darquette[/url] or send an email to; support@double11.com. 


D.Arquette 
Community Experience and QA Tester

notes.title: PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate out, brings sequel to PC for the first time
notes.content:
The PixelJunk series is a sorta-related bunch of shootery, rhythmy, racingy games, mashing genres together like pixel minestrone. The first PixelJunk Shooter (it's a twin-stick shooter, but also an exploration game) came to the PC back in 2013, while its sequel remained in PlayStation land until last week.

PixelJunk Shooter 2 is now on PC. Sort of, anyway. You won't find it on Steam, but you will find PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate, which mashes both the original game and its follow-up together. They've been grafted into one continuous game, while the art of both games has been overhauled. Confusing? Maybe. Here's developer Q-Games explaining what's what:

"We ve combined Shooter 1 and 2 to make a seamless story mode featuring all of the levels from the two games. We ve also changed up the Graphics and UI of both games, we ve completely overhauled them to create the new Ultimate art style. Among a host of changes and improvements that make, what we believe, this to be the best edition of the game ever for Steam."

There are a raft of other changes detailed at the preceding link, including a new treasure tracker that lets you know how much loot is in each area, and even a Photo mode. If you own the original, and you have a save file, you'll be able to import it into Ultimate and play the sequel's levels without having to do all the original ones first. There are also discounts—a launch discount, and various other discounts for owners of previous PixelJunks—going on for the next day and a bit. (Ta, PCGamesN.)

notes.title: Full Flow: PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate Out Now
notes.content:
The PixelJunk Shooter [official site] games are home to my favourite fluid simulation systems. In a time when digital boxes, barrels and bodies drop, flop and break in fascinating and convincing fashion, liquids are still depicted as still, glassy surfaces far too often. The two Shooter games – collected together in the new Ultimate release which marks the sequel’s first appearance on PC – are 2D arcade/puzzle games that combine the physics of Thrust with superbly realised lava, water, oil and acid.

notes.title: Welcome to PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate
notes.content:
Hey folks,

We are proud to announce, in our continued collaboration with Kyoto based Q-Games, that [b]PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate[/b] is out [b]TODAY![/b]

This Steam edition is the product of much love, time and energy between our two studios and we believe it’s the best ever edition of PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate!

[b]So what is PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate?[/b]
PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate is a twin-stick shooter with equal elements of action, exploration and puzzle solving.
Saving scientists and uncovering the mysteries of an ill-fated research trip requires you to study and manipulate your environment. Blast and dig through rock and ice, unleashing floods of water, lava, gas, magnetic oil and even deadly stomach acid, all powered by an advanced fluid mechanics simulation.

[b]What’s new in PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate?[/b]
We’ve combined [b]Shooter 1[/b] and 2 to make a seamless story mode featuring all of the levels from the two games. We’ve also changed up the Graphics and UI of both games, we’ve completely overhauled them to create the new ‘Ultimate’ art style. Among a host of changes and improvements that make, what we believe, this to be the best edition of the game ever for Steam.

The new features include:
[list]
    [*][b]Shooter 1[/b] and 2 combined featuring all of the levels from the two games.
    [*]The Graphics and UI overhauled to create the new ‘Ultimate’ art style.
    [*]The scoring, combo and rewards systems have been improved.
    [*]We added a host of new features to make it easier for players to 100% complete the game – including a treasure tracker so players know how many treasures are in each area and progress indicators on each level so players always know what they missed.
    [*]You can switch between the new [i]‘Ultimate’[/i] art style and the [i]‘Classic’[/i] art style at any time.
    [*]Keyboard & Mouse support with full Key Rebinding available.
    [*]Steam Achievements, Leaderboards and Trading Cards.
    [*]Rebalanced Online Battle mode which makes it much quicker to progress through the ranks and unlock new items.
    [*]A new Photo Mode which allows players to instantly pause the game and remove the HUD for beautiful screenshots.
[/list]

[b]I have PixelJunk Shooter 1, can I use my save data in PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate?[/b]
Yes, you can carry your save file from [b]PixelJunk Shooter[/b] into [b]Shooter Ultimate[/b], when you first boot up [b]Shooter Ultimate[/b] it’ll ask if you want to do this. Meaning those with Save Data can jump straight into the [b]PixelJunk Shooter 2[/b] levels.

We look forward to you guys trying it out and giving us feedback, for more information on [b]PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate[/b] [url=http://double11.co.uk/game/pixeljunk-shooter-ultimate/steam]Click HERE[/url].

If you come across any issues please feel free to send them to us at: [url=http://support.double11.co.uk/]support.double11.co.uk[/url]

[B]Discounts?[/b]
As a reward for fans of the series, all owners of [b]PixelJunk Shooter[/b] will receive a 20% off discount, all owners of any [b]PixelJunk Series[/b] title will receive an additional 5% off per game. This will also include the already 10% off launch sale price for an up to max of 45% off [b]PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate[/b]. The discounts will automatically be applied through Steam, as well as select other retailers and they will expire November 3rd.

Hopefully this has answered some of your questions, if not feel free to ask below or feel free to ask via our [url=https://twitter.com/DoubleElevenLtd]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/D11_Darquette]my own[/url]. 

[url=http://double11.co.uk/game/pixeljunk-shooter-ultimate/steam]For more information on [b]PixelJunk Shooter Ultimate[/b] Click here[/url].

D.Arquette
Community Manager and QA Tester @ Double Eleven
